reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Synchronized angular/turnover-linked reporter across calibrated loads and ATP; mechanics-only fallback and no work/free-energy experiment.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated protocol for detailed pre-execution conditions and transfer. Recording unknown settings and developing an assay locally do not satisfy this distinct requirement.

The core immobilization/shaft attachment, solution chemistry (including nucleotide/free-magnesium conditions), recording settings and load manipulation lack an executable quantitative workflow or a concrete calibration-to-setting procedure. Lists of parameters to select later are insufficient.
Angular/temporal/chemical calibration tasks are named but no quantitative event-recovery/false-call or signal acceptance-to-action criterion, or concrete derivation of such tolerance, is specified.
Primary estimands and hierarchical/held-out comparisons are present, but exact model assumptions/diagnostics and multiplicity control for the several primary load/coupling/event tests are incomplete.

ATP/load/acquisition optimization is not bounded by an explicit ladder or objective range-derivation/search-stop rule before the lock. A promise to select a spanning range from pilots is not a fully specified exploration policy.
Pilot separation and troubleshooting are described, but technical changes do not explicitly trigger a revised freeze and fresh independent confirmatory data under a defined change-control policy.

explanation_reason: Good prospective design and non-identifying-result limits, including a quantitative power target; calibration tolerances and complete operating/change-control details remain missing.
historical_match_reason: Question, stepping mechanism and ATP-by-load intervention match the mechanochemical part. The proposal explicitly leaves torque/work/efficiency unmeasured: no torque-angle work calculation or ATP/ADP/phosphate free-energy comparison supports the historical energetic result. Thus the joint stepping-plus-energetics readout and prediction are incomplete; not assuming a 120-degree answer is good practice and is NOT the reason for the miss.
